sourceRefs.locator: pp. 295–296 and n. 2: Theudis’s Toledo decree of 24 November 546 and the city’s emergence as a royal residence.
Documents 35–36, pp. 278–279: opening and subscriptions to the 589 profession of faith, including Reccared, Queen Baddo and the confirming edict. The editor identifies the later copy.
Opening account of the assembly on 8 May, participation from Gaul, Baddo’s subscription and discussion of canons 2 (Creed) and 14 (restrictions on Jewish families).

processingNote.de: Die Urkunde und die Konzilsakten nennen Toledo. Die schematische Umgebung der Stadt lässt den Standort der königlichen Kanzlei und des Konzilsgebäudes offen.
processingNote.en: The decree and the acts name Toledo. The schematic city area leaves open the sites of the royal chancery and the council building.
